reviews.comment: Not a hard class but Attend EVERY lecture he will offer extra credit and if you show up he will be more likely to bump your grade this whole class is three exams, a video, and one journal entry. Exams are open note and online but the final had questions based on pictures based on what he talked about so pay attention. Boring class but a free A
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr Howell is a great professor! He genuinely wants his students to succeed in class and offered several opportunities for extra credit. He took participation in class but it wasn't counted towards our grade. The only graded assignments were exams and a heavily weighted reading journal. The final was online and not super difficult

Dr. Howell has been one of my favorite professors at A&M so far. His class is more lecture focused, but there are outside readings that can help. There are only 4 grades in this class, but his grading criteria is very clear and the assignments/exams are not very difficult. As long as you go to class, take notes, and study a bit you should be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Howell is very knowledgeable about what he teaches and has a clear passion for it. At times his lectures can get dull, but if you love history you'll enjoy his class. Everything he tests is covered in lecture so the reading is really unnecessary. He grades fairly and lays out his expectations clearly in order for students to succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof Howell is a very nice professor, and is not trying to fail you. His lectures can get a little boring, but overall they are very helpful and he does a good job at explaining the course. there's 2 exams worth 150 points each, with the final being 300 points, and a very simple written assignment worth 400. Easy weight and good study guides!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Howell was very understanding and wants you to succeed. He helped me learn how to study for his class when I bombed the first exam and helped me ace all the rest of the exams. Lots of reading but exams are doable if you do your work. He also gives a good amount of extra credit!

Dr. Howell is a fantastic professor who is well-read in his area. His lectures are, admittedly, a bit boring, but he gives all the information you need for the exams. There is a lot of reading to do, but the exam questions are broad enough that you don't need all of the smaller details in the readings. If you read and go to class, you'll do great!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a good guy, but lectures go off track. By week 3 we were already behind. You'll teach yourself most of the content, so READ THE TEXTBOOK and use his study guides. Tests include MC, written, and an essay. Final was online (not as listed in syllabus). Bring a different blue book for each test.

Professor Howell was a nice guy. His tests are pretty easy and the final was take home and open book, open note. He has pop quizzes that are online in class, but if you miss them he will let you make it up. All of the exams, except the final, are on paper and have multiple choice and then an essay portion. He gives test reviews that are helpful.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very nice professor. The lectures can be a bit boring, but Professor Howell knows what he's talking about. There are 3 exams, 2 writing assignments, and 5 pop quizzes. The textbook and lectures are not necessary. Flashcards were all I needed to get a 95 in this class. None of the assignments or exams were difficult at all.

Easy and straightforward.  Homework is unlimited attempts and straight from the book, and exams are take-home and open book.  One 2-3 page essay.  Sometimes attendance is graded via a form you fill out in class.  I never once paid attention to lecture and still got an A, so I'd just got for the attendance and sit in the back and do math homework.

he's a nice guy, he changed 2 of the exams to in person but the final still online, attendance was not mandatory, however there were 5 pop quizzes so you would need to be there for those, the quizzes are online and easy, no text book needed, assignments are so easy, i ended up with an 97 and dont even like history
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's such a nice guy but sooooo soft spoken! It was hard to hear him during class. He changed the exams to in person, but they were pretty easy. Really sweet guy, cracks a joke here and there. Really noticeable that he knows what he's talking about. Would give surprise extra credit.

Professor Howell is nice and answers emails quickly, but his lectures are unnecessary. There are a few participation quizzes but they barely impact your grade. The exams are online and open note, and all questions are straight from the book. The exams are long and challenging though. Homework is super easy and online, and there is one paper.

Nice guy, but his lectures were essentially useless. By the end of the semester, the lecture hall was nearly empty because all of the homeworks are completion, and all the exams are online open note & open textbook. The exams are quite hard but all answers can be found in the textbook, which makes his lecture kind of a waste of time.

Very easy class. A few participation quizzes only taken in class, but worth almost nothing toward your final grade. Exams are take home and open note. Only one paper in this class and he's picky about the formatting. Very chill professor.

Everything other than tests was completion based, tests were take home open note,100 questions with an hour to do them. Did take attendance and had quizzes attached to attendance but other than that he literally just went over what you read in the textbook in class. Nice man except he gave me a zero for missing a quiz because my great grandpa died.

Dr. Howell is a great lecturer and straightforward with assignments. There's about one a week based on the textbook chapter, but it's impossible to get below 100% if you do it. There's 4 online tests, the last one being 20% cumulative. There's only one other paper and he is a really relaxed grader, so overall an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very easy class. The homework, while annoying and something you have to pay a little bit of money for, is easy to brute force. Exams are on Canvas and open note, so if you have even the slightest understanding of the subject, you will do just fine. Take this professor for the easy A and relaxed requirements.

This was the easiest history class I've ever taken in my life. Lectures are extremely boring, but you don't have to go because attendance is worth 1% of your grade through pop quizzes, and all the assignments and exams are online and open note. You won't learn anything, but if you just need the credit, take this class for an easy A.

Exams and all assignments are online. Lectures are pretty interesting to listen to and are basically summaries of the textbook (I did not read the textbook because of this). If you attend lectures you do not need to study for the exams because what was said in lecture sticks in your brain. Definitely take this prof for HIST 105.

This was professor Howell's first semester teaching 106. I really liked him as a professor, but the lectures were boring. Attendance is mandatory but nothing taught in the lectures were on the test. Tests are 100 questions in 75 minutes. Grade 2was based on little assignments (super easy), 3 online exams (that are open note), and 1 writing paper.

Professor Howell was an excellent professor! All assignments and exams were online and super easy. There are 3 exams. There was one writing assignment but it was very straightforward and easy to do. He does 5 participations quizzes throughout the semester so make sure to not skip all the time. If you have the chance, take him! Super easy class!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: If "put the fries in the bag bro" was a person. Dr. Howell is very monotone and quite frankly hard to understand due a deep east Texas accent. He is also very heavy on lectures, most of which are a single slide. He also goes on and on so be ready to fall asleep. The course itself was easy, his methods just made it hard. Stay away.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took Professor Howell's online course at AMU/APUS.  Very helpful.  Assignments were clear.  Fast grader.  Would definitely recommend him!

He's pretty relaxed other than the first test being hard the following test were take home and boosted your grade, you also get participation grades for showing up, so the more days you miss the lower your participation grade is.

He does lots of group participation with the chapters to help you understand the chapters better. The first Test given was hard, but the rest were take home to make up for it and they were fairly easy, just time consuming.  I would definetly recommend this Proffesor.
His mlnatone voic, long lectures, and unineresting way of teaching makes it diff. to stay awake in class. Stay away from Howell. Tests are all esay based. Although he does give you a review.
